title: gagea durieui subsp. iberica
intro: Gagea durieui subsp. iberica, commonly known as Spring Snowdrop, is a plant species that belongs to the family Liliaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Spring Snowdrop plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Gagea durieui subsp. iberica include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
